name: aider
competence: Surgical edits to one or a few named files, committed to git automatically; needs the target to be identified up front
weaknesses: will not explore a repo to find its own target

unattended.note: `--yes-always` in the base contract already answers every confirmation

plan.note: architect edit format: reason out the change, then apply it (the flag form of the in-chat /architect command)

readonly.note: runs the edit loop without writing anything to disk

no_op.prompt_prefix: Your previous run described this work instead of doing it. Do not restate the plan -- make the edits on disk now, and finish by listing the files you changed. Task:
no_op.note: re-dispatch with an explicit apply-the-edits instruction

stuck.prompt_prefix: You are running headless: nobody can answer a question, and asking one ends the run with nothing done. Make reasonable assumptions, complete the task, and record those assumptions in your final message. Task:
stuck.note: re-dispatch telling the agent no answer can arrive

failed.prompt_prefix: A previous attempt failed and its commit has been rolled back with /undo. Start from the current tree state. Task:
failed.note: aider auto-commits, so /undo rolls the failed attempt back before the retry starts
